actions.name: ransomware attacks targeting the Food and Agriculture sector
actions.description: Ransomware attacks targeting the Food and Agriculture sector disrupt operations, cause financial loss, and negatively impact the food supply chain.

actions.name: exploit network vulnerabilities to exfiltrate data and encrypt systems
actions.description: Cyber criminal threat actors exploit network vulnerabilities to exfiltrate data and encrypt systems in a sector that is increasingly reliant on smart technologies, industrial control systems, and internet-based automation systems.

actions.name: encrypt victims' files and demand payment for decryption tool and key
actions.description: In a ransomware attack, victims’ files are encrypted and made unavailable, and the attacker demands a payment for the decryption tool and key.

actions.name: exfiltrate sensitive data files prior to encryption and demand payment not to publish
actions.description: Sensitive data files are commonly exfiltrated prior to encryption, and the attacker demands a payment not to publish the sensitive data on a “name-and-shame” website.

actions.name: apply additional coercive tactics to ensure payment
actions.description: Threat actors may apply additional coercive tactics such as convincing media organizations to write stories on victim security incidents, harassing employees by phone, notifying business partners of data theft, and conducting distributed denial of service attacks to further disrupt operations.

actions.name: broaden attack from IT and business processes to operational technology assets
actions.description: Cyber actors may gradually broaden their attack from just information technology (IT) and business processes to also include the operational technology (OT) assets, which monitor and control physical processes, impacting industrial production regardless of whether the malware was deployed in IT or OT systems.

actions.name: deploy Sodinokibi/REvil ransomware through software used by an IT support MSP
actions.description: In July 2021, a US bakery company lost access to their server, files, and applications, halting their production, shipping, and receiving as a result of Sodinokibi/REvil ransomware which was deployed through software used by an IT support managed service provider (MSP).

actions.name: compromise computer networks using a variant of Sodinokibi/REvil ransomware
actions.description: In May 2021, cyber actors using a variant of the Sodinokibi/REvil ransomware compromised computer networks in the US and overseas locations of a global meat processing company, resulting in possible exfiltration of company data and shutdown of some US-based plants for several days.

actions.name: cause shortage in US meat supply and increase wholesale meat prices
actions.description: The temporary shutdown reduced the number of cattle and hogs slaughtered, causing a shortage in the US meat supply and driving wholesale meat prices up as much as 25 percent.

actions.name: cause significant disruption to business operations of a US beverage company
actions.description: In March 2021, a US beverage company suffered a ransomware attack that caused significant disruption to its business operations, including operations, production, and shipping. The company took its systems offline to prevent further spread of malware.

actions.name: gain administrator level access through compromised credentials
actions.description: In January 2021, an unidentified threat actor was able to target internal servers of a US farm by gaining administrator level access through compromised credentials.

actions.name: conduct ransomware attack causing $9 million loss due to temporary shutdown
actions.description: In January 2021, a ransomware attack against an identified US farm resulted in losses of approximately $9 million due to the temporary shutdown of their farming operations.

actions.name: conduct ransomware attack using phishing email with malicious zip file attachment
actions.description: In November 2020, a US-based international food and agriculture business reported it was unable to access multiple computer systems due to a ransomware attack conducted by OnePercent Group threat actors using a phishing email with a malicious zip file attachment.

actions.name: download several terabytes of data through identified cloud service provider prior to encryption
actions.description: The cybercriminals downloaded several terabytes of data through their identified cloud service provider prior to the encryption of hundreds of folders.
